subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the address that is exactly the same as the one given below.

House No. 18, Sector 17, Chandigarh - 160017
solution:
House No. 18, Sector 17, ChandIgarh - 160017 ('I' instead of 'i' in word Chandigarh)

House No. 18, Sector i7, Chandigarh - 160017 (i7 instead of 17) 

House No. 18, Sector 17, Chandigarh - 160017 (***Exactly same***)

House No. 18, Sector 17, Chandigerh - 160017 (Spelling mistake in word Chandigarh)

Hence, the correct option is **Option (3).**
